business_purpose: Tracks downstream lifecycle state changes, formal approval bounds, and specific underwriting policies triggered.
business_question_supported: What was the final decision on the application, what terms were authorized, and which policy rules were violated?
grain: One record per closed application processing event (application_id).
dataset_type: Event/transaction dataset tracking contract lifecycle resolutions.
storage_and_ingestion: Micro-batch pipeline executing every fifteen minutes to move structured underwriting system logs directly into an analytics layer.
ai_consumption: Functions as direct decision-support feedback loops to recalibrate deep learning underwriting thresholds over time.
ai_assumption: Assumes all historical fields are immutable and free from retrospective manual processing adjustments.

columns.business_meaning: Unique contract or file identifier indicating a finalized underwriting lifecycle step.
The cross-reference key identifying the individual applicant bound to this specific underwriting determination.
The specific loan configuration framework applied to this transaction evaluation.
The ultimate outcome or state of the contract parsing through the credit policy rules engine.
The authorized capital amount extended to the consumer, capped strictly by product configurations.
